measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: length, width and thickness of the board
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: centre-to-centre spacing of the four corner holes (along length and along width) and hole diameter
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge

measures.what: height of the USB-C port opening above the ESP32 top face, port opening width, and its position along the board length from the board end nearest the port
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 position: in female headers on the perfboard's columns 8 and 18, rows 2 to 23; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge

measures.what: ESP32 DevKitC board length and width, and total height from its top face to the tallest component on the top side (e.g., header or pin tops)
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board

measures.reply: led disk hole to edge: 102.54 from the outside of one hole to the disk's edge, and 102.24 from the other hole to the other side mm; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.reply: perfboard thickness: I can't measure that
